summary: The pairwise ledger argument itself is mathematically sound, but the proof contains an explicit false assertion that the three centroid caps form a partition up to null boundary pieces.
critical_errors: The proof calls C_1, C_2, C_3 a partition up to null boundary pieces, but it has just computed that every pairwise intersection C_i\cap C_j has area a_1/9>0. Thus these caps are a cover with positive-area overlaps, not a partition even modulo null sets.
repair_hints: Delete the partition assertion or replace it with the accurate statement that the three caps cover A_1 and have the displayed positive-area pairwise overlaps. This sentence is not used by the subsequent ledger argument.
